in_sanskrit.name: ललितदित्य
in_sanskrit.meaning: Delight of the Gods, God of Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ललित (Lalita) meaning 'Delight', 'Grace' and दित्य (Ditya) meaning 'Goddess'. So, Lalitaditya means 'Delight of the Gods' or 'God of Grace'. He is also known as Lalitaditya Srivastava in Indian History and Mythology.

in_hindi.name: ललितदित्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: सब (Sab) meaning 'All', लित (Lit) meaning 'Delight' and दित्य (Ditya) meaning 'Goddess'. So, Lalitaditya in Hindi means 'All Delighting Goddess'.

in_tamil.name: லலிததிட்ய
in_tamil.long_meaning: லலித (Lalitha) meaning 'Grace', 'Delight' and திட்ய (Tidya) meaning 'God' or 'Goddess'. So, Lalitaditya in Tamil means 'God or Goddess of Grace and Delight'.

in_telugu.name: లలితదిట్య
in_telugu.long_meaning: లలిత (Lalitha) meaning 'Grace', 'Delight' and దిట్య (Ditya) meaning 'Goddess'. So, Lalitaditya in Telugu means 'Goddess of Eternal Grace and Delight'.

in_marathi.name: Lalitaditya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalitaditya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalita: lovely, pleasing to the senses; Ditya: god. This name signifies a god who is pleasing and lovely.

in_bengali.name: Lalitaditya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lovely God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lalitaditya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lalita: lovely, pleasing to the senses; Ditya: god. This name signifies a god who is pleasing and lovely.

vedic_reference.note: Lalitaditya is a famous king mentioned in Indian History and Mythology. He is known as Lalitaditya Srivastava in Indian History and Mythology. He was a great king of the Chalukya Dynasty in Karnataka, India. He ruled during the 7th and 8th centuries CE. He is known for his military conquests and his patronage of arts, literature, and education.
